name: Target Circle Card (RedCard) - credit / Target Mastercard
notes: Tier 2. Researched from public target.com pages only (no sign-in). The Target Circle Credit Card and Target Mastercard are issued by TD Bank USA and managed on 'Manage my Circle Card' (target.com/mycirclecard, served from mytargetcirclecard.target.com), where cardholders sign up or log in, pay the credit card bill, set alerts, view transactions and update personal information. The sign-in page itself is a script-rendered app that could not be read, so auth fields stay at the family default (inferred). Automated phone line (English or Spanish, 24 hours): verify with the 16-digit card number, make a one-time payment or schedule one up to 30 days ahead, review payment history and request a recent statement; payments after 11 p.m. CT post the next day. The online scheduling horizon is not published, so billing.scheduled is not set. Mail: Target Card Services, P.O. Box 660170, Dallas, TX 75266-0170. Contact page numbers: Target Circle Credit Card 1-800-424-6888, Target Circle Mastercard 1-612-815-9922 (catalog number 1-800-659-2396 replaced by contact.phone). Online payment method types are not stated on the public pages; bank only is inferred (the card's own checking-account draw is for the debit card, not the credit card). AutoPay, paperless statements, fees and account closing are not described on the public pages and stay at the family defaults. Target Circle Cards cannot be added to Apple Pay or Google Pay; the Target app Wallet barcode applies the card at checkout.

guest_pay.note: Online payments are made after you log in to Manage my Circle Card. Without logging in, pay through the 24-hour automated line at 1-800-424-6888 or by mail.

help.title: Ways to pay your Target Circle Card
paragraphs: Online: sign up for or log in to Manage my Circle Card to pay your Target Circle Card credit card bill. The same site lets you set alerts, view transactions and update your personal information.

By phone: the automated system works 24 hours a day in English or Spanish. Have your 16-digit card number ready. You can make a one-time payment or schedule one up to 30 days ahead, review your payment history and request a recent statement. Payments made after 11 p.m. Central time post the next day.
By mail: send your payment to Target Card Services, P.O. Box 660170, Dallas, TX 75266-0170.

help.title: Contact Target Circle Card
paragraphs: Target Circle Credit Card: 1-800-424-6888. Target Circle Mastercard: 1-612-815-9922. Payments by mail go to Target Card Services, P.O. Box 660170, Dallas, TX 75266-0170.

help.title: Using your card in the Target app Wallet
paragraphs: Target Circle Cards can't be added to Apple Pay, Google Pay or Samsung Pay. Add the card to Wallet in the Target app instead: one barcode applies your Target Circle offers, Weekly Ad coupons and your Target Circle Card at checkout.
